about.en: Expose an incorrect declaration with cases

about.zh: 证明完毕：没有目标剩下
变成测试列出的几种结果（每种是它的目标）；一种也没有：这一步失败
about.en: the results the test lists, each its goals; none: the step fails

about.zh: 证不出时停下，报告证不出
about.en: to stop and report failure when the goal cannot be proved

about.zh: 找出所有答案：?-字母取到的每一种
about.en: every answer: each thing its ?-letters can become

about.zh: 解完的等式（能合一时），或者失败
about.en: the solved equations (when they unify), or a failure

about.zh: 推出空子句 ⊥（测试有预算时，子句不超过预算）
about.en: the empty clause ⊥ (within the test’s budget of clauses)

about.zh: 能推出 ⊥ 时推出 ⊥；否则饱和
